data_fields.name: spawn_interval
data_fields.donor_constant: 6000 (default); one value fixed, or two values as a random range via Util.RandomInRange

data_fields.name: spawn_table
data_fields.donor_constant: list of actor names, picked uniformly

data_fields.name: spawn_point_types
data_fields.donor_constant: type set; matches spawners that overlap it or have no types

best_idea: Keep a zone's live population between a minimum and a maximum by spawning on a randomised interval from typed spawn points, and refilling to the minimum in one burst when it is below.
decision_why: Cap, interval, typed spawn points and minimum burst are the zone-population shape we need, but the donor counts with a hook that drifts when a removal path skips it, so Frankendom should count the live server roster instead.
acceptance: A server test in a zone with maximum 4 and a 600-tick interval kills all 4 creatures and asserts one spawn per interval until the minimum is back, never above the maximum; a second test removes one creature by leash and by kill and asserts the count drops by one each time with no extra call.
